articles.title: Hakuba: Guidewire’s Newest Release Drives Profitability with Autopilot Workflow Service and More

articles.summary: As with elsewhere in the world, across the Nordic region, we have seen how geopolitical events and the consequent effects on international markets have affected the insurance industry. Concerns around rising interest rates and costs continue to affect market dynamics. This pressure now sits alongside the need to innovate, improve efficiency, and provide products that respond to evolving customer needs. So, what can insurers in the Nordic region do to mitigate the impact of these changes, and how can they still be open to new opportunities in the industry?
articles.title: Don’t play the waiting game, the opportunities for Nordic insurers are here now

articles.summary: In the digital age, our teams have even more flexibility when it comes to how we work through our Work From (almost) Anywhere Program. Read about how Megha leveraged her time at Guidewire to make a long-awaited visit home to see her mum and family in India.
articles.title: Work From Anywhere: Megha's Go Global Adventure

articles.summary: In the escalating battle against cybercrime, insurers need cutting-edge tools to accurately evaluate constantly morphing digital risks. Cyence has answered the call with the release of Model 6, our most advanced cyber risk modeling platform yet.
articles.title: Staying Ahead of the Curve: Cyence Launches Model 6 to Confront Emerging Cyber Threats
